<DOCSTRING>
Logs the result of an operation.

Records the operation, its operands, and the result for audit and debugging purposes.

@operation {string} - The operation performed (e.g., "add", "subtract").
@a {number} - The first operand.
@b {number} - The second operand.
@result {number} - The result of the operation.
</DOCSTRING>
